E1334

An explicit workspace member is not a Package directory

What

An explicit workspace member is not a Package directory

Why

Workspace membership names existing Package roots; a missing or manifest-free directory cannot become a stable graph node.

Fix

Create `package.jet`, correct the path, or use `find("./packages")`.
